field_irreducibility.ordinal: Irreducible for representation-independent replay order. Without an explicit local ordinal, H_d/H_x and H_x/H_d can be conflated whenever the transport or equality layer canonicalizes rows independently of container position; the UNKNOWN barrier can likewise be moved illegally.
field_irreducibility.event_class: Irreducible because transition shape alone is not semantic provenance: UNKNOWN may share an immediate q transition with a known/no-op observation while remaining non-commutable, and H_d versus non-D evidence must remain class-distinct at each ordinal.
field_irreducibility.q_before: Irreducible in a self-contained uniform row schema without an external initial-state header. Removing it loses the first event precondition and prevents detection of distinct pre-states or illegal clears that can lead to the same q_after.
field_irreducibility.q_after: Irreducible in a self-contained uniform row schema without an external terminal-state header. Removing it loses the last event result and prevents exact reconstruction of the terminal evidence state and immediate transition direction.
field_irreducibility.deferred_mask: Irreducible because two rows can have identical ordinal,event_class,q_before,q_after yet differ in latent may-change effects; conflating them can incorrectly erase or commute UNKNOWN and violates the zero-transition-mask-plus-zero-deferred-effects guard.
field_irreducibility.changed_mask: Reducible: exact function q_before XOR q_after; storing it is an integrity cache only and equality must recompute it.
field_irreducibility.verdict_before: Reducible: exact function V(q_before); retaining it is an audit cache only.
field_irreducibility.verdict_after: Reducible: exact function V(q_after); retaining it is an audit cache only.
